items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: And that was an alto? Alto, yeah.

ctx.x: Alto, yeah. And you know what? It must have been a Conn because it had one of those screw things on it. Because I even forgot what — like in those days, I mean it didn’t mean anything, Conn or whatever, it was a saxophone.
But it was probably an old, the silver color one?
